title: Factorized position x role finite-group views
hypothesis: For an analytic expert orbit generated by C4 cyclic position shifts x C2 semantic-role swaps, two independently paid group coordinates over one shared operator will recover held-out compositions exactly and use at least 20% fewer actual bytes than eight independent operators. A native direct-coordinate control should be within 10% bytes at equal quality; failure of that margin means no Mirror-specific advantage. A ninth off-orbit operator should require private state.
physical_object: one 8x8 shared linear operator over four positions and two semantic roles
mirror_coordinate: independent C4 position index and C2 role-swap index
logical_multiplicity: eight position-role compositions generated by C4 x C2, including two held-out compositions
controls: nine independent operators including off-orbit task
flat table of six seen compositions
native direct position/role coordinate control with the same deterministic action
group action with and without private ninth off-orbit operator

development.selection_metric: held-out composition nMSE, payload bytes, number of distinct functions, group-action covariance error

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP32 inference payload bytes after reload

success_gate: All fresh worlds: both held-out compositions have nMSE <=1e-10; factorized payload <=0.80x independent eight-operator payload; direct coordinate control <=1.10x Mirror bytes at equal quality; no-private off-orbit quality and private fallback bytes explicitly reported; deterministic payload replay.
failure_gate: Held-out composition quality misses 1e-10 in at least two fresh worlds; or storage savings versus independent are <20%; or native direct coordinates match within 10% bytes and quality (FAIL for Mirror-specific advantage).
boundaries: synthetic analytic linear operator orbit, not trained attention or language-model evidence
two group coordinates do not imply eight independent capacities
the two held-out compositions are unseen task IDs but their group generators are known
no optimizer updates; teacher composition is analytic
report any stabilizer that reduces distinct functions
